text:
Before: one fried egg (~46 g, ~90 kcal), one slice of toast (~30-40 g, ~90 kcal), avocado slices (~70 g, ~110 kcal), and coffee with milk and sugar (~240 g, ~30 kcal with sugar, maybe 2 packets at 8 kcal each).

After: the egg is gone, with a bit of yolk left. The toast is gone. Avocado has about 3 slices left, about 30% of the original. The coffee is mostly drunk, with a small amount left. Both sugar packets were used.

Avocado eaten: roughly 70% of 70 g, so about 50 g and 80 kcal.
Egg: about 43 g and 85 kcal.
Toast: about 35 g and 90 kcal.
Coffee: about 200 g and 40 kcal, including milk and sugar.

Total: about 295 kcal. Mass: 50 + 43 + 35 + 200 = 328 g, which I round to 330 g.
